bootstrap_control_repair.reason: Leaving controlled idle exposed three reset-era assertions that encoded the freeze itself rather than the invariant behind it: two hard-coded the literal controlled_idle state and one used PS-OPPORTUNITY-SLATE-001 as its example of an inactive lane. Together they made the activation policy unusable, because any real activation failed the build meant to validate it. This exact branch repairs those three assertions only, so they evaluate activation from a forced-idle ledger copy and derive the inactive package and the bootstrap branch/SHA from the ledger instead of pinning today's values. No product, schema, pipeline, release, or production behaviour changes, and no control is weakened: a ledger that wrongly permits a paused package is still rejected.
bootstrap_control_repair.inert_after_merge: The exception requires the exact branch and origin/main SHA. The branch is deleted after merge, and any later checkout is behind current origin/main.
